name: Corrupt Primal of Air

facts.text: The four Corrupt Primals rise at the waterfall bridge after the voices; Olcasgean wakes only when all four are dead. Their shared line is 'We shall protect.'
Level 83 with only 900 health; it flies, never melees and never walks home. Pets and turrets deal a fixed 5 per hit; direct damage kills it.

story: The wind of Hy Brasil was the first of the four to be taken, the Sylvan say, because wind goes everywhere and so went down into the hollow before anything else. The Root kept it. Now it circles high over the bridge, a little knot of stale air that has forgotten how to blow. It has almost no body to wound, and it knows it: it never comes down to fight, never closes, never flees, only hangs there while its kin do the killing. Beasts and summoned things claw at it uselessly, for there is nothing to claw. A single honest spell of the right weight will scatter it. The trick is to remember it is there.
legend: Air goes first and it goes fast: one good nuke from below kills it. Pets and turrets are useless on it, so send them at the others. Casters and archers look up the moment the primals spawn. Forget it and it will hang over the bridge all night while its kin do the killing.

aggro: The wind remembers nothing but the Root.

lairEntry: Four voices speak as one: we shall protect.

phases.text: A breath of clean wind crosses the bridge.

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: The wind over Galladoria is free again.
